# Extract sub-regions - fixed
def extract_subregions(grid, h_separators, v_separators):
    regions = []
    # Regions are between separators, including the separator index-1
    h_ranges = []
    last = -1
    for s in h_separators:
        h_ranges.append([last + 1, s - 1])
        last = s + 1
    h_ranges.append([last, len(grid) - 1])
    
    v_ranges = []
    last = -1
    for s in v_separators:
        v_ranges.append([last + 1, s - 1])
        last = s + 1
    v_ranges.append([last, len(grid[0]) - 1])
    
    for hi, (start, end) in enumerate(h_ranges):
        for vi, (start, end) in enumerate(v_ranges):
            subgrid = [row[start:end+1] for row in grid[start:end+1]]
            regions.append((hi, vi, subgrid))
